# Generate Schema JSON

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `schemas.generate-json` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/schemas.yaml` |
| Tags | schema, workflow |

Emits one `.json` file per definition that declares a `schema:` block, by
iterating `runtime.catalog.definitions` and filtering on `has_schema`.
Defaults write into `01_schemas/` next to the authoring YAML.

### Run Operations

#### Emit one `.json` per schema definition

_No operation description provided._

```schema_json
schema_json:
  definition: '{{ definition.id }}'
  target_path: '{{ output_dir }}/{{ definition.id }}.json'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
  indent: '{{ indent }}'
for_each:
  items: runtime.catalog.definitions | selectattr('has_schema') | rejectattr('id',
    'equalto', 'schemas.base') | list
  as: definition
```
